The user wants to detect when the LSP server crashes or becomes unresponsive and automatically restart it.
I have a plan with 3 phases:
1. [en_curso] A locator: dónde se detecta que el servidor LSP se ha caído o no responde para disparar el reinicio
2. [pendiente] B locator: dónde se reinicia el servidor LSP automáticamente tras detectar una caída (hacia reinicio)
3. [pendiente] P puente: hay camino detectar la caída y reiniciar el servidor (need A B)

I have done 4 explorations for phase A.
T1, T2, T4 all found `restart lsp for workspace`, `schedule debounced lsp restart`, `run`, `on lsp missing install`.
T3 found `notify lsp status`, `ensure python lsp async`, `finish python lsp start locked`.
The pack shows `T1=>T2 mismo objeto`, `T1=>T4 mismo objeto`, `T2=>T4 mismo objeto`.
This means T1, T2, T4 are looking at the same code/object.
T3 is different (`sin camino` from T1, T2, T4).
